Left (arm still): drive-mate's align 60-90 s/part (servo rounds ~6 s each, 2 in-hand base reads), ExecuteMate ~24 s/mate re-measuring every predecessor, line_green's nudge 66 s (and it drags the free base ~18 mm) 10-23 run 31 (u_brown 175 s, u_orange 290 s, line_green 430 s with its recovery): fixed - in-hand base fits were all rejected against the seed's height (21cf428); line_green's pre-pick search ~20 s (d5f3dc6); the nudge slid line_green 18 mm past its seat (b60c28a). Run 32 ~1200 s with recovery; next sinks: line_green recovery, ExecuteMate ~20 s/mate, pick prep ~37 s/part 10-23 03:45 run 34: 4/4 hands-off, one uninterrupted run, cycle_time wall 968 s (arm moving 35%). Still-time sinks: drive-mate aligns ~255 s (camera reads, 2 in-hand base reads, wrist turns), line_green recovery 130 s (the bar pivots in the jaws, -y end 2-4 mm past the pocket end, nudge seats it), ExecuteMate ~20 s/mate, move_to_grasp 56 s 04:14 run 35: 4/4 hands-off, 944 s (U aligns 93 -> 59 s: one in-hand base read, servo moves in process). After it: depth-servo moves in process, taps 9.9 -> 6.9 s, certify's base read stops spending ~15 s on a read it discarded (the ExecuteMate server ran without BASE_FROM) 04:46 run 36: 4/4 hands-off, 880 s (certify 9-12 s each) 05:33 run 37: 4/4 hands-off, 919 s (4 uninterrupted runs: 968/944/880/919). line_green's axial grasp error measured from the held outline over bare table (2.8 mm toward -y, MAD 1.1 px): the depth servo now corrects the aim by it when it cannot re-read the base in hand (83e63e5, first in run 38) 06:08 run 38b: 4/4 hands-off, 829 s - line_green seated from the insert with no nudge (depth servo ran fully, robust far-edge rule, corridor search found the 2.5 mm across error). Run 38 before it stopped: u_brown jammed +20 mm x3 with a converged servo and the same held pose (unexplained) 06:34 run 39: 4/4, 854 s - line_green seated with no recovery via the held-outline correction (3.7 mm along); its 50-probe across search -> left edge added (194249c) 07:30 run 41: 4/4, 850 s; line_green from the insert in 10 probes (held outline, both edges), the certifier's +2.34 mm end read recovered by taps + re-certify (6b87c60). rungs.title: Depth timing: how long after the arm stops is depth reliable
rungs.note: frames taken while moving are ~10 mm off and no time shift fixes them; after the stop they are right at once; they arrive 150 ms (p90 650 ms) late. Rule: frames stamped >= 0.25 s after the TCP stopped (no fixed sleeps); immediate reads = reads 3 s later within 0.2 mm. Left: a 1-4 mm per-view bias

rungs.note: 10-21: same static base1 read by the 6-dof CAD fit from 12 views (top-down z0.52/0.60 x yaw 0/+-60, tilted 20/30 from +-x/-y; 0.9-1.3 mm rms each): xy spread median 2.1 max 5.1 mm, yaw 0.94 deg, z 6.5 mm; tilted views worst (y -439..-449). A rigid 6-dof mount correction does not help (leave-one-out 2.7 -> 2.7 mm): not a hand-eye offset - depth intrinsics or arm kinematics next. Until fixed: compare reads from the same view geometry, top-down certification only; the touch insert absorbs the residual. Top-down base views agree with the arm on tilt (base1 ~0.5 deg toward +x). Survey: ablations/logs/handeye_icp/20261021_200144. CLEARS AT: seated end heights within +-1 mm in every view.
